output.answer_markdown: The filings do not state any future amount Pfizer expects to pay for the Upjohn spin-off. They describe costs already incurred: Pfizer incurred separation-related costs of $434 million in 2020 [1]. Pfizer also states that it is no longer the obligor or guarantor of any Upjohn debt or financing arrangements [2].
